tokenize_khmer_texts: tokenize a list of Khmer language text strings into word tokens using the CRF-based segmenter
segment_khmer_text: segment a Khmer sentence into spaced words using the CRF model and KCC feature predictions
segment_into_kccs: segment a Khmer sentence into Khmer Character Clusters by splitting on zero-width space boundaries
create_kcc_features: create a list of feature dictionaries for each KCC including context window of up to 3 neighbors
classify_khmer_char_type: classify a single Khmer character as consonant, vowel, subscript, diacritic, or no-space type
